query:
query EntityFixturesAndResults($entityId: Int, $entityType: String, $season: String, $comps: [CompInput], $teams: [String], $type: String, $skip: Int, $limit: Int) {
  getEntityFixturesAndResults(
    season: $season
    comps: $comps
    teams: $teams
    entityId: $entityId
    entityType: $entityType
    type: $type
    limit: $limit
    skip: $skip
  ) {
    ...Fixtures_fixture
    __typename
  }
}

fragment Fixtures_fixture on FixtureItem {
  id
  compId
  compName
  dateTime
  group
  isLive
  isBye
  round
  roundType
  roundLabel
  season
  status
  venue
  sourceType
  matchLabel
  homeTeam {
    ...Fixtures_team
    __typename
  }
  awayTeam {
    ...Fixtures_team
    __typename
  }
  fixtureMeta {
    ...Fixtures_meta
    __typename
  }
  __typename
}

fragment Fixtures_team on Team {
  id
  name
  teamId
  score
  crest
  __typename
}

fragment Fixtures_meta on Fixture {
  id
  ticketURL
  ticketsAvailableDate
  isSoldOut
  radioURL
  radioStart
  radioEnd
  streamURL
  streamStart
  streamEnd
  broadcastPartners {
    ...Fixtures_broadcastPartners
    __typename
  }
  __typename
}

fragment Fixtures_broadcastPartners on BroadcastPartner {
  id
  name
  link
  photoId
  __typename
}
